arxiv-2104-13839.title: Structural averaged controllability of linear ensemble systems
arxiv-2104-13839.creator: Bahman Gharesifard, Xudong Chen
arxiv-2104-13839.description: Abstract In the paper, we introduce and address the problem of structural averaged controllability for linear ensemble systems. We provide examples highlighting the differences between this problem and others. In particular, we show that structural averaged controllability is strictly weaker than structural controllability for single (or ensembles of) linear systems.

arxiv-2308-05553.title: Prikry type forcings and the Bukovský-Dehornoy phenomena Thanks: This document is based on a tutorial lectures that were given in Torino, in the 8th European Set Theory Conference. This research was supported by the Israel Science Foundation 1967/21.
arxiv-2308-05553.creator: Yair Hayut
arxiv-2308-05553.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yair Hayut. This paper is meant to present in a coherent way several instances of quite common phenomena that was first identified (independently) by Bukovský and Dehornoy. We present the basic result for Prikry type forcing and show how to extend it to the Gitik-Shraon forcing, the Extender Based Prikry forcing, Prikry forcings with interleaved collapses and Radin forcing for o ⁡ ( κ ) < κ + o(\kappa)<\kappa^{+} .

arxiv-2309-13168.title: FATHER: FActory on THE Road
arxiv-2309-13168.creator: Géza Szabó, Balázs Tárnok, Levente Vajda, József Pető, Attila Vidács
arxiv-2309-13168.description: Abstract In most factories today the robotic cells are deployed on well enforced bases to avoid any external impact on the accuracy of production. In contrast to that, we evaluate a futuristic concept where the whole robotic cell could work in a moving platform.

arxiv-2502-08510.title: Moment Estimator-Based Extreme Quantile Estimation with Erroneous Observations: Application to Elliptical Extreme Quantile Region Estimation
arxiv-2502-08510.creator: Jaakko Pere, Pauliina Ilmonen, Lauri Viitasaari
arxiv-2502-08510.description: Abstract In many application areas of extreme value theory, the variables of interest are not directly observable but instead contain errors. In this article, we quantify the effect of these errors in moment-based extreme value index estimation, and in corresponding extreme quantile estimation. We consider all, short-, light-, and heavy-tailed distributions.

arxiv-2510-02632.title: On the invariant surface area functionals in 3-dimensional CR geometry
arxiv-2510-02632.creator: Pak Tung Ho
arxiv-2510-02632.description: Abstract . Cheng, Yang, and Zhang have studied two invariant surface area functionals in 3-dimensional CR manifolds. They deduced the Euler–Lagrange equations of the associated energy functionals when the 3-dimensional CR manifold has constant Webster curvature and vanishing torsion. In this paper, we deduce the the Euler–Lagrange equations of the energy functionals in a more general 3-dimensional CR manifold.

arxiv-2511-14300.title: Vortex stability in pseudo-Hermitian theories
arxiv-2511-14300.creator: R. A. Battye, S. J. Cotterill, P. Millington
arxiv-2511-14300.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by R. A. Battye, S. J. Cotterill, P. Millington. Pseudo-Hermitian (including 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} -symmetric) field theories support phenomenology that cannot be replicated in standard Hermitian theories. We describe a concrete example in which the vortex solutions that are realised in a prototypical pseudo-Hermitian field theory exhibit a novel metastability, despite the model parameters residing within the naively stable regime of exact antilinear symmetry of the vacuum theory.

arxiv-2512-20421.title: Irreversibility and randomness
arxiv-2512-20421.creator: Nino Dekkers
arxiv-2512-20421.description: Abstract We make precise sense of the idea of “molecular chaos” through algorithmic randomness of microscopic trajectories, and ground macroscopic irreversibility in the lack of symmetry under time reversal of this property. This concept of randomness is defined relative to an underlying probability measure ℙ \mathbb{P} on the space of trajectories.

pmc-11431398.title: Estimating the Extraction Time of an Upper Third Molar: Proposal and Validation of Results

pmc-11657486.title: Adaptation in adversity: innovative approaches to food security amidst COVID-19 in a remote First Nations community in Canada
pmc-11657486.creator: Fatima Ahmed, Robert J Moriarity, Nicholas D Spence, Gisele Kataquapit, Celine Sutherland, Nadia A Charania, Leonard J S Tsuji, Eric N Liberda
pmc-11657486.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The COVID-19 pandemic exacerbated food insecurity issues in geographically isolated communities, including Fort Albany First Nation (FAFN). This research examines FAFN’s adaptive strategies to improve food security, highlighting community resilience and leadership. Data were gathered through semi-structured interviews with 20 community members who were involved in the pandemic response, either as members of the pandemic committee or as managers of community programs.

pmc-12538818.creator: Md. Shahjalal, Padam Kanta Dahal, Md. Parvez Mosharaf, Yifu Chen, Mohoua Azmary, Edward Christopher Dee, Khorshed Alam, Rashidul Alam Mahumud

pmc-13589345.description: BackgroundGlycyrrhiza spp. are medicinal legumes that produce a wide array of pharmacologically active secondary metabolites. uslaw-usc-t43-s618a1.title: 43 U.S.C. § 618a–1 — Availability of Colorado River Development Fund for investigation and construction purposes
uslaw-usc-t43-s618a1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s618a1.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 12A (Boulder Canyon Project); Subchapter II (Boulder Canyon Project Adjustment Act). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The availability of appropriations from the Colorado River Development Fund for the investigation and construction of projects in any of the States of the Colorado River Basin shall not be held to forbid the expenditure of other funds.
